responsibility: Provides a small legacy convenience layer for constructing simple GIMPLE assignments and casts. Its helpers infer result types, create fresh SSA-name temporaries when needed, and build common unary/binary assignment forms and NOP_EXPR type-conversion statements for middle-end transforms that want higher-level statement creation wrappers around gimple_build_assign.
same_name_distinction: Implements the legacy builder helper overloads by creating temporaries/SSA names, inferring RHS types, and calling gimple_build_assign for assignments and NOP_EXPR casts, whereas the header only exposes those helper declarations.
